BUSINESS OVERVIEW
================================================================================

Business Name: Alaska Golf Carts
Industry: Golf Cart Dealership / Neighborhood Electric Vehicles (NEV)
Business Type: Florida Statewide Golf Cart Dealer
Phone: 1-888-840-4490
Phone (E.164): +18888404490
Email: info@alaskagolfcarts.com
Website: https://alaskagolfcarts.com
Service Model: Florida statewide — no physical storefronts
State Served: Florida (FL) — statewide, all 67 counties
Statewide Delivery: Yes (all 67 Florida counties)

Alaska Golf Carts is one of the largest Florida statewide golf cart dealerships in the
state of Florida. The company specializes in the sale of new
and used golf carts, neighborhood electric vehicles (NEVs), and low-speed
vehicles (LSVs). Alaska Golf Carts serves residential communities, golf courses,
commercial properties, resorts, and individual consumers across Florida.

Primary Keyword: golf carts for sale
Secondary Keywords: affordable golf carts, used golf carts for sale, electric golf carts for sale

================================================================================
  FLORIDA STATEWIDE SERVICE AREA
  ================================================================================

  Alaska Golf Carts is a Florida statewide golf cart dealership. Rather than
  operating from individual storefronts, Alaska Golf Carts serves the entire state
  of Florida — all 67 counties — with sales, delivery, financing, parts, and
  service. Nationwide delivery is also available.

  State Served: Florida (FL), United States
  Coverage: All 67 Florida counties
  Headquarters: Statewide Service, Florida
  Nationwide Delivery: Yes

  Florida Counties Served (all 67):
  Alachua County, Baker County, Bay County, Bradford County, Brevard County, Broward County, Calhoun County, Charlotte County, Citrus County, Clay County, Collier County, Columbia County, DeSoto County, Dixie County, Duval County, Escambia County, Flagler County, Franklin County, Gadsden County, Gilchrist County, Glades County, Gulf County, Hamilton County, Hardee County, Hendry County, Hernando County, Highlands County, Hillsborough County, Holmes County, Indian River County, Jackson County, Jefferson County, Lafayette County, Lake County, Lee County, Leon County, Levy County, Liberty County, Madison County, Manatee County, Marion County, Martin County, Miami-Dade County, Monroe County, Nassau County, Okaloosa County, Okeechobee County, Orange County, Osceola County, Palm Beach County, Pasco County, Pinellas County, Polk County, Putnam County, St. Johns County, St. Lucie County, Santa Rosa County, Sarasota County, Seminole County, Sumter County, Suwannee County, Taylor County, Union County, Volusia County, Wakulla County, Walton County, Washington County

BRANDS CARRIED
================================================================================

Alaska Golf Carts is an authorized dealer for the following golf cart and NEV brands:

1.  American Custom Golf Carts - Custom-built golf carts and LSVs
2.  Bintelli - Electric vehicles and golf carts
3.  Club Car - Industry-leading golf cart manufacturer (Ingersoll Rand)
4.  COLEMAN - Utility and recreational electric vehicles
5.  COLUMBIA - Commercial and personal electric vehicles
6.  CRICKET - Compact mini golf carts and neighborhood vehicles
7.  Denago - Electric golf carts and low-speed vehicles
8.  Evolution - Electric golf carts with advanced features
9.  EZGO (E-Z-GO) - Textron brand, premium golf carts
10. Icon - Electric vehicles and golf carts
11. Star EV - Star Electric Vehicles, versatile golf carts
12. Tara - Golf carts and neighborhood electric vehicles
13. Yamaha - Global manufacturer of golf carts and utility vehicles

- Club Car Precedent: Modern design, advanced engineering
- Club Car Tempo: Latest generation, premium features and technology

DENAGO:

- Denago Rover XL: 4-passenger electric golf cart
- Denago Rover XL6: 6-passenger electric golf cart

EZGO (E-Z-GO):

- EZGO RXV: Premium golf cart with AC drive technology
- EZGO TXT: Popular model, versatile applications

EVOLUTION:
- Evolution Carrier 6 PLUS: 6-passenger with enhanced features
- Evolution D5 Maverick 6: 6-passenger premium electric vehicle
- Evolution D5 Ranger 4: 4-passenger premium electric vehicle

STAR EV:
- Star EV CLASSIC: Traditional golf cart design with modern features

TARA:

YAMAHA:

- Yamaha G22: Mid-generation classic golf cart
- Yamaha G29 (The Drive): Popular versatile golf cart

================================================================================
SERVICES OFFERED
================================================================================

SALES:
- New golf cart sales from all authorized brands
- Used / pre-owned golf cart sales
- Electric golf carts (battery-powered, zero emissions)
- Gas/gasoline-powered golf carts
- Street-legal golf carts (LSVs meeting FMVSS 500 requirements)
- Lifted golf carts (suspension lift kits installed)
- Custom golf cart builds and configurations

FINANCING:
- 0% APR financing available (through Sheffield Financial)
- Financing terms up to 48 months
- Six lending partners: Sheffield Financial, BLI Heartland (rent-to-own),
  DLL Financial Solutions, Roadrunner/Octane, Univest Capital, Dealer Direct
- Flexible payment plans for most credit profiles
- Business/commercial financing available

PARTS & ACCESSORIES:
- OEM replacement parts for all brands carried
- Aftermarket accessories and upgrades
- Batteries and chargers
- Tires and wheels
- Seats and upholstery
- Windshields, tops, and enclosures
- Lighting kits (headlights, taillights, turn signals)
- Lift kits and suspension components
- Audio systems and entertainment
- Custom body kits and trim

SERVICE & REPAIR:
- Factory-trained technicians
- Routine maintenance and tune-ups
- Battery diagnostics and replacement
- Motor and controller repair
- Brake service and repair
- Electrical system diagnostics
- Body repair and refurbishment
- Warranty service for all brands

DELIVERY:
- Nationwide delivery available; statewide service throughout Florida
- Call 1-888-840-4490 for delivery quotes
